releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.201: Home Screen widget buttons expand equally to the available width. The widget can be resized left-right only; text size and side padding adapt to its width. Vertical resizing is disabled. Individual 3D press feedback and all four independent shortcuts are preserved.
webReleaseNotes: Removed the temporary Web Update 363 test label from the Me screen. No other Diary feature or APK change.
